caption: The drawing displays an irregularly shaped, rectangular patch positioned at the center of a plain off-white or beige background. The patch appears to be a detailed illustration of a cross-stitched textile, composed of clustered short lines mimicking embroidery threads. The main colors used in the patch are red, green, black, and a background of light beige. The topmost section is predominantly red, featuring stylized, roughly horizontal lines and clusters resembling text and leafy motifs. Below that, there is a horizontal band filled with black, blocky letters on a beige and green base. Further bands alternate between red text and green, interspersed with red and green geometric or floral patterns. The bottom section is dense with black, leaf-like or star-shaped motifs arranged in repeating patterns. The overall shape of the patch is uneven, with jagged, stepped edges, and the borders are defined by the placement of the cross-stitched lines. There is also a light, small handwritten inscription near the bottom left corner of the page.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
